blocks.text: LANTAPAN, Bukidnon — The ube harvest of local farmers here, who are mostly members of the Talaandig indigenous tribe, is set to enter the United States market after they secured a five-year contract to supply the increasingly globally popular purple yam for export. The contract was formalized last October 5 at the Northern Mindanao Agricultural Crops and Livestock Research Complex in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon, under the auspices of the Department of Agriculture Regional Field Office 10 (DA-RFO 10). The agreement links the DA, agribusiness firm Verueco Ventures Corp., and two local cooperators Lantapan Ube Planters Association and the Balugto Hope Agroforestry Association […]...
